title: The contrast between real and $p$-adic integrability
summary: One of the most intriguing questions in $p$-adic symplectic geometry is to what extent it captures phenomena outside of real symplectic geometry. Since symplectic geometry has its origins in classical mechanics, and since integrable systems are essentially physical systems with many conserved quantities, it is natural to ask if considering the same system with coefficients in $\mathbb{R}$ and $\mathbb{Q}_p$ respectively, will lead us to see the same or different behaviors.
